walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Autodesk Platform Services (Standalone App)
walkthroughs.description: Register an APS app, upload a design, and preview it in the Viewer.

steps.title: Create a new APS app
steps.description:
Every APS integration starts with an app registered on the APS portal. If you don't have one yet, create an app of type "Traditional Web App".

[Open APS Portal](https://aps.autodesk.com/myapps)

media.altText: Screenshot of creating a new app on the APS portal

steps.title: Register your client ID and secret
steps.description:
Copy the client ID and secret of your new app into a new APS "environment" for this extension. The extension will prompt you for these values automatically the first time it activates with no environments configured; you can also add or update them anytime from the settings.

[Open Extension Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22autodesk.forge.environments%22)

media.altText: Screenshot of registering the client ID and secret in the extension settings

steps.title: Create an OSS bucket
steps.description:
Buckets are the top-level containers for your designs in the Object Storage Service. Open the Data & Derivatives (app) view and create your first bucket.

Note that bucket names must be globally unique - if you see a `409 Conflict` error, choose a different name.

[Create Bucket](command:aps.oss.createBucket)

media.altText: Screenshot of creating a new OSS bucket

steps.title: Upload a design file
steps.description:
Upload a design file (for example, an RVT, IPT, or DWG file) to your new bucket.

[Upload Object](command:aps.oss.uploadObject)

media.altText: Screenshot of uploading a design file to a bucket

steps.title: Translate the file
steps.description:
Translate your design with the Model Derivative service so it can be viewed in the browser.

[Translate Object](command:aps.md.translateObject)

media.altText: Screenshot of translating a design file

steps.title: Preview the 2D/3D outputs
steps.description:
Once translation finishes, preview the generated 2D/3D derivatives directly in a new editor tab, powered by the APS Viewer.

[Preview Derivative](command:aps.md.previewDerivative)

media.altText: Screenshot of previewing a translated design in the Viewer

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Autodesk Platform Services (Forma Integration)
walkthroughs.description: Sign in with your Forma account and browse hubs, projects, and designs as that user, right from VS Code.

steps.title: Create a new APS app
steps.description:
Every APS integration starts with an app registered on the APS portal. If you don't have one yet, create an app of type "Traditional Web App".

[Open APS Portal](https://aps.autodesk.com/myapps)

media.altText: Screenshot of creating a new app on the APS portal

steps.title: Register your client ID and secret
steps.description:
Copy the client ID and secret of your new app into a new APS "environment" for this extension. The extension will prompt you for these values automatically the first time it activates with no environments configured; you can also add or update them anytime from the settings.

[Open Extension Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22autodesk.forge.environments%22)

media.altText: Screenshot of registering the client ID and secret in the extension settings

steps.title: Provision access in Autodesk Forma
steps.description:
In your Forma hub, go to Hub Admin > Custom Integrations > Add custom integration, and enter the same client ID as your APS app to grant it access to the hub's data.

[Manage API Access to Forma (docs)](https://aps.autodesk.com/en/docs/acc/v1/tutorials/getting-started/manage-access-to-acc/)

media.altText: Screenshot of adding a custom integration for a client ID in Forma Hub Admin

steps.title: Log in with your Forma account
steps.description:
Open the Data & Derivatives (user) view and sign in, choosing "3-legged OAuth" when prompted. A browser window will open for you to log in with your Forma account.

[Sign In](command:aps.auth.login)

media.altText: Screenshot of signing in to APS with a Forma account via 3-legged OAuth

steps.title: Browse hubs, projects, folders, designs, and versions
steps.description: Expand the tree in the Data & Derivatives (user) view to browse your Forma hubs, projects, folders, designs (items), and their versions.

media.altText: Screenshot of browsing hubs, projects, folders, and designs in the Data & Derivatives (user) view

steps.title: Preview a design version
steps.description: Expand a design version to see its derivatives, then preview one directly in a new editor tab, powered by the APS Viewer.

media.altText: Screenshot of previewing a design version's derivative in the Viewer

languageModelTools.name: aps_listBuckets
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the OSS buckets of the current APS environment.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all Autodesk Platform Services (APS) Object Storage Service (OSS) buckets owned by the application of the currently selected APS environment, including their bucket keys, retention policies, and creation dates.

languageModelTools.name: aps_createBucket
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a new OSS bucket in the current APS environment.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new Autodesk Platform Services (APS) Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket in the region of the currently selected APS environment. Bucket keys must be globally unique, 3-128 characters long, and may only contain lowercase letters, digits, and the characters '-', '_', and '.'.

bucketKey.description: Globally unique key (name) of the new bucket.

policyKey.description: Retention policy of the bucket: 'transient' (24 hours), 'temporary' (30 days), or 'persistent'. Defaults to 'transient'.

languageModelTools.name: aps_listObjects
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the objects in an OSS bucket.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all objects in an Autodesk Platform Services (APS) Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket, including their object keys, object IDs, and sizes.

languageModelTools.name: aps_uploadFile
languageModelTools.userDescription: Upload a local file to an OSS bucket.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Uploads a local file to an Autodesk Platform Services (APS) Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket. The file path may be absolute or relative to the first workspace folder.

filePath.description: Absolute path of the local file to upload, or a path relative to the first workspace folder.

objectKey.description: Key (name) of the new object in the bucket. Defaults to the file name.

languageModelTools.name: aps_translateObject
languageModelTools.userDescription: Start an SVF2 translation of an OSS object.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Starts an Autodesk Platform Services (APS) Model Derivative translation of an object in an OSS bucket into the SVF2 format (2D and 3D views) so that it can be viewed in the APS Viewer. Existing derivatives are replaced. Use the aps_getTranslationStatus tool to check the progress of the translation.

objectKey.description: Key (name) of the object in the bucket.

languageModelTools.name: aps_getTranslationStatus
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get the translation status of an OSS object.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets the status and progress of the Autodesk Platform Services (APS) Model Derivative translation of an object in an OSS bucket (from its manifest), including the status of each derivative. Fails if the object has not been translated yet.

objectKey.description: Key (name) of the object in the bucket.

languageModelTools.name: aps_listWebhookEvents
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the systems and events available for APS webhooks.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists the Autodesk Platform Services (APS) webhook systems (e.g. 'data', 'derivative', 'adsk.c4r') and their events, including the scopes supported by each event. Use this to find valid inputs for the aps_createWebhook tool.

system.description: Optional ID of a webhook system to restrict the list to.

languageModelTools.name: aps_createWebhook
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a webhook for an APS event.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates an Autodesk Platform Services (APS) webhook that calls the given callback URL whenever the given event of the given system occurs within the given scope (for example, system 'data', event 'dm.version.added', scope 'folder' with a folder URN). Use the aps_listWebhookEvents tool to find valid systems, events, and scopes.

system.description: ID of the webhook system, e.g. 'data' or 'derivative'.

event.description: ID of the event, e.g. 'dm.version.added' or 'extraction.finished'.

callbackUrl.description: URL to be called when the event occurs.

scopeValue.description: Value of the webhook scope, e.g. a folder URN for the 'folder' scope.

scopeKey.description: Key of the webhook scope, e.g. 'folder' or 'workflow'. Defaults to the first scope supported by the event.

filter.description: Optional JsonPath filter expression applied to the event payload.

authContext.description: Whether to create the webhook with the application's credentials ('app', default) or on behalf of the signed-in user ('user').
